description.en: DSH-side cordis plugin paired with an AstrBot plugin: it picks up queued tasks from cache/inbox, writes the results back to cache/outbox, and reports task completion to the local AstrBot HTTP endpoint so the notice reaches the user from their own chat account.
description.zh: 与 AstrBot 插件配套的 dsh 侧 cordis 插件：从 cache/inbox 领取队列里的任务、把结果写回 cache/outbox，并调用本机 AstrBot 接口上报任务完成，让通知以用户自己的聊天账号送达。
